name_zh: 费萨尔一世/建国元勋：部落联邦制治理与伊拉克建国
name_en: Faisal I/Founding Fathers: Tribal Federal Governance & Iraqi State-Building
description_zh: 费萨尔一世 (1885-1933) 哈希姆王朝，阿拉伯大起义领袖，叙利亚短暂称王 (1920)，英属委任统治下任伊拉克首任国王 (1921-1933)。核心治理挑战：超部落/超教派/超族群建国——逊尼/什叶/库尔德/亚述/犹太/马安达教共存。治理机制：部落酋长纳入议会/内阁(部落联邦制)、逊尼王室平衡什叶多数(教派共治)、石油特许权 (1925 IPC) 换取基建/军队现代化、1930 年英伊条约换取名义独立加入国联。体现 M170 部落联邦制治理——部落自治+中央名义主权+外部保护伞的脆弱平衡。
description_en: Faisal I (1885-1933), Hashemite, Arab Revolt leader, briefly King of Syria (1920), installed as Iraq's first King under British Mandate (1921-1933). Core governance challenge: supra-tribal/sectarian/ethnic state-building—Sunni/Shia/Kurd/Assyrian/Jewish/Mandaean coexistence. Mechanisms: tribal sheikhs into parliament/cabinet (tribal federalism), Sunni monarchy balances Shia majority (sectarian power-sharing), oil concession (1925 IPC) trades for infra/military modernization, 1930 Anglo-Iraqi Treaty exchanges nominal independence for League of Nations entry. Exemplifies M170 Tribal Federal Governance—tribal autonomy + nominal central sovereignty + external security umbrella, fragile equilibrium.
reason_zh: 伊拉克建国是"人为边界+天然分裂"的极限拼图：赛克斯-皮科协定划线、奥斯曼三省(巴格达/巴士拉/摩苏尔)强行合并。费萨尔以哈希姆合法性+部落联邦制+外交平衡，在英/法/土/波/沙五强夹缝中争取生存空间。M170 区隔于 M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)、M149 伊斯兰咨询(决策)，核心在于"部落联邦制作为人为国家的生存操作系统"。
reason_en: Iraq's state-building is 'artificial borders + natural divisions' extreme puzzle: Sykes-Picot lines, three Ottoman vilayets (Baghdad/Basra/Mosul) forcibly merged. Faisal leverages Hashemite legitimacy + tribal federalism + diplomatic balancing to carve survival space among UK/France/Turkey/Iran/Saudi five-power squeeze. M170 distinct from M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage) and M149 Islamic Shura (decision), core: 'tribal federalism as survival OS for artificial nation'.
steps_zh: 哈希姆合法性移植：叙利亚失位→伊拉克称王，血统合法性跨国迁移
部落联邦制制度化：酋长进入议会/内阁，部落法庭并行国家司法，税收分成
教派平衡艺术：逊尼王室/什叶多数/库尔德自治，内阁按教派比例分配 (穆哈萨萨雏形)
石油换基建/军队：1925 IPC 特许权→铁路/公路/皇家伊拉克军队，主权部分兑换
外交生存平衡：1930 英伊条约入国联→1933 费萨尔猝逝→加齐/阿卜杜勒-伊拉维摄政→1958 君主制倒台
steps_en: Hashemite legitimacy transplant: lost Syria -> installed in Iraq, lineage legitimacy cross-border transfer
Tribal federalism institutionalization: sheikhs in parliament/cabinet, tribal courts parallel state judiciary, revenue sharing
Sectarian balance art: Sunni monarchy/Shia majority/Kurdish autonomy, cabinet by sectarian quota (muhasasa prototype)
Oil for infra/military: 1925 IPC concession -> rail/road/Royal Iraqi Army, partial sovereignty exchange
Diplomatic survival balance: 1930 Anglo-Iraqi Treaty -> League of Nations -> 1933 Faisal sudden death -> Ghazi/Abdulilah regency -> 1958 monarchy fall
expected_zh: 人为边界国家以"部落联邦制+教派权力分享+外部保护伞"三支柱维持脆弱统一，为后殖民国家建国提供反面教材与生存范式。
expected_en: Artificial-border nation maintains fragile unity via trinity of 'tribal federalism + sectarian power-sharing + external security umbrella', providing both cautionary tale & survival paradigm for post-colonial nation-building.
case_zh: 1921 费萨尔加冕→1925 IPC 石油→1930 英伊条约入国联→1933 费萨尔猝逝→1958 卡西姆政变君主制终结，37 年王朝在部落/教派/外部裂隙中崩塌。
case_en: 1921 Faisal crowned -> 1925 IPC oil -> 1930 Anglo-Iraqi Treaty -> League of Nations -> 1933 Faisal sudden death -> 1958 Qasim coup monarchy ends, 37-year dynasty collapses in tribal/sectarian/external fissures.
cross_cultural_impact: Tribal federalism model for artificial states; Hashemite legitimacy transfer; mandate-to-independence template
spiritual_tradition: Sunni Islam (Hashemite) / Shia majority / Kurdish secular
colonial_history: Ottoman 1534-1918; British Mandate 1920-1932; British military presence 1932-1958
diaspora_influence: Iraqi Jewish diaspora (1950-51 airlift); Assyrian diaspora; Shia scholarly networks to Iran/Najaf
